subject.callable: direct Triton float32 warm-buffer Nesterov SGD state transition
subject.boundary: one launch with sixteen Triton programs reading the complete parameter, gradient and old momentum buffer and writing every parameter and momentum-buffer coordinate in place

tasks.task_statement: Perform one complete public torch.optim.SGD state transition on one received dense float32 parameter and its existing momentum buffer with lr 0.125, momentum 0.75, dampening 0, weight_decay 0.25, nesterov and maximize enabled, and return both complete post-states.

input_map.basis: the kernel uses the exact binary value 0.125
the kernel uses the exact binary value 0.75
the kernel has no dampening term
the kernel adds the exact binary coupled L2 term 0.25*theta
the kernel adds momentum times the new buffer to the processed gradient
the kernel negates the received gradient before weight decay
one direct elementwise launch is bound to the non-foreach public task choice
the binding does not claim PyTorch's internal fused implementation
the selected public state transition is non-differentiable
